first_session_policy.rule: Prefer a curated first-session ritual only when it remains semantically competitive; relevance and SUPPORT FIRST safety always win.

top_50.name: BLINK RESET
top_50.mind_bend: A natural blink can divide experience into before and after. Ordinary bodily events already provide boundaries for resetting attention.

top_50.name: NEAR-FAR JUMP
top_50.mind_bend: Switching between near and far objects makes depth itself the attentional dimension. Attention can travel through distance as well as across direction.

top_50.name: IF-FRAME
top_50.mind_bend: An absolute statement changes once a single condition is made explicit. Hidden ‘if’ clauses often sit underneath mental certainty.

top_50.name: RULE BOUNDARY
top_50.mind_bend: A personal rule can be accurate in one context and overextended in another. Validity is bounded by conditions rather than guaranteed by familiar wording.

top_50.name: FACT-FEELING-ASK
top_50.mind_bend: Fact, feeling and ask can occupy separate channels in one message. This indicates how conflict grows when observation, experience and request are blended together.

top_50.name: BOUNDARY LOOP
top_50.mind_bend: A boundary can survive repetition without acquiring new reasons. Explanation is not what gives a limit its legitimacy.

top_50.name: THOUGHT LATENCY
top_50.mind_bend: There is measurable space between a cue and the mind’s response, so reaction can have latency even when it feels instantaneous.

top_50.name: TYPEWRITER DELAY
top_50.mind_bend: Character-by-character display reveals how much of reading normally happens ahead of awareness; the mind wants to predict text before the text has arrived.

top_50.name: OPPORTUNITY-COST SHADOW
top_50.mind_bend: Choosing one use of scarce time or money silently chooses against its best alternative. Opportunity cost is part of the decision even when it is invisible.

top_50.name: REGRET PAIR
top_50.mind_bend: Regret can come from acting or from not acting, and comparing both on the same horizon exposes omission as a decision path with consequences too.

top_50.name: EMOTION ORB
top_50.mind_bend: A feeling can be represented with a boundary around it. Emotional presence does not require the emotion to occupy all of inner space.

top_50.name: EMOTION ACTION BLOCK
top_50.mind_bend: An emotion can produce a clear action urge while the action remains unperformed. Feeling, impulse and behaviour are three distinguishable stages.

top_50.name: BAD FIRST MOVE
top_50.mind_bend: An intentionally imperfect first move can create real progress before correction. Perfection is a quality-control process instead of a prerequisite for action.

top_50.name: FRICTION HUNT
top_50.mind_bend: Start resistance often spikes at one identifiable point. Procrastination is local friction that can be targeted rather than a global personality trait.

top_50.name: PRONOUN ZERO
top_50.mind_bend: Self-talk can retain its subject matter after personal pronouns disappear. Identity markers are additions to content rather than the content itself.

top_50.name: ROLE EXIT
top_50.mind_bend: A role can be mentally left when its task ends. Responsibilities do not have to remain active inside identity after the situation is over.

top_50.name: VOLUME LADDER
top_50.mind_bend: Inner-voice loudness can be adjusted while every word stays fixed. Volume is a presentation property rather than part of the message itself.

top_50.name: ROBOT READ
top_50.mind_bend: When expressive prosody is removed, the same words lose part of their emotional force; tone is carrying information the sentence never states.

top_50.name: NO-SEQUEL
top_50.mind_bend: The first thought and its explanatory sequel are separate events; rumination begins in what gets added after the thought is already complete.

top_50.name: STAMP COMPLETE
top_50.mind_bend: A simple completion marker can change whether the mind treats material as still open. Closure signals influence revisiting even without changing content.

top_50.name: CARD EDGE
top_50.mind_bend: An image can become almost invisible edge-on while remaining the same imagined object, separating what exists in representation from what a viewpoint makes visible.

top_50.name: MIRROR FRAME
top_50.mind_bend: Horizontal reflection preserves the scene while reversing left-right relations. The shift makes clear how recognition can survive a major change in orientation.

top_50.name: QUEUE MASTER
top_50.mind_bend: Mental overload can come from simultaneous competition, not sheer quantity; sequencing the arrivals changes the pressure without deleting any of them.

top_50.name: BUFFER CLEAR
top_50.mind_bend: Working memory can be intentionally left empty for a few beats after one task segment. The next task need not occupy the buffer immediately.

top_50.name: BIRTH CATCHER
top_50.mind_bend: A spontaneous thought has a beginning you can catch, separating the arrival of mental content from the act of choosing it.

top_50.name: HEADLINE CUT
top_50.mind_bend: Compressing a long monologue to five words reveals how little information may sit underneath a large amount of mental narration.

top_50.name: SENSATION LOCATION SWITCH
top_50.mind_bend: Moving attention from a mild sensation to neutral contact changes what pulls awareness without requiring the sensation itself to change, separating salience from physical intensity.

top_50.name: TENSION LOCATION
top_50.mind_bend: Tension can be located in one obvious area without launching a whole-body search. A local sensation does not require global surveillance.

top_50.name: SKILL BOUNDARY
top_50.mind_bend: One mistake can be contained to the exact skill that failed. This underscores how performance errors become identity threats only when they spread beyond their actual boundary.

top_50.name: STUMBLE IMMUNITY
top_50.mind_bend: A deliberate harmless stumble can be left behind while performance continues. Restart and correction are optional responses rather than consequences built into error.

top_50.name: SAFE PLACE FEATURE
top_50.mind_bend: One genuine feature of a safe place may be enough to contact safety information, separating a real cue from an elaborate fantasy of perfect protection.

top_50.name: GOODNESS WITHOUT STORY
top_50.mind_bend: Something can be simply okay before any explanation of why. Positive fact is separable from the story used to justify or amplify it.

top_50.name: SLOW ROOM SCAN
top_50.mind_bend: Scanning a room extremely slowly changes the tempo of visual search. Speed itself is a feature that can amplify or soften the sense of scanning for something.

top_50.name: BODY HEAVY IMAGERY
top_50.mind_bend: Imagining the support surface carrying more of the body’s weight can change felt heaviness without changing the surface. Bodily support is part sensation and part representation.

top_50.name: SOCIAL STATUS STRIP
top_50.mind_bend: Removing titles, brands or status symbols while keeping behaviour fixed exposes how symbolic rank can alter judgments of the same person and interaction.

top_50.name: ONE-FRIEND ANCHOR
top_50.mind_bend: A vague imagined crowd changes when reduced to one known safe person. This illustrates how social threat can be amplified by representing many unknown observers as one undifferentiated mass.

top_50.name: ONE HELP LINE
top_50.mind_bend: Human help may begin with one plain sentence rather than a complete explanation. Connection is an action that can happen before you have perfect words.

top_50.name: SAFE COMPANION
top_50.mind_bend: Asking someone to stay converts support from an idea into shared physical time. Companionship is a practical safety resource during high activation.

top_50.name: PIXEL PANIC
top_50.mind_bend: A troubling image can retain its identity while losing almost all spatial size. Visual dominance and informational content are different properties.

top_50.name: FUTURE WEATHER
top_50.mind_bend: Forecast confidence can change like weather without invalidating the person making the forecast. Uncertainty is updateable rather than as a verdict that must stay fixed.

top_50.name: URGE + CHOICE
top_50.mind_bend: An urge and a chosen action can remain visible together. Desire need not disappear before behaviour can follow a different path.

top_50.name: URGE AUCTION
top_50.mind_bend: Urge, value and consequence can compete under the same finite token budget. Action is the outcome of multiple claims rather than whichever feeling shouts loudest.

top_50.name: VALUES WITHOUT ROLE
top_50.mind_bend: A value can remain meaningful after one role is mentally removed. Values are deeper continuity that need not depend on a particular title or position.

top_50.name: LOSS CARRY
top_50.mind_bend: A valued quality can be carried forward from something that ended without claiming the loss was good. What changes is continuity of value alongside genuine absence.

top_50.name: LOOP COUNTER
top_50.mind_bend: A repeated thought may feel productive while contributing nothing new; information gain, not mental motion, is what distinguishes thinking from looping.

top_50.name: ONE-TAKE RULE
top_50.mind_bend: One complete viewing can end without a restart. Replay is an additional mental action rather than an unavoidable continuation of the original clip.

top_50.name: FIRST MINUTE AFTER
top_50.mind_bend: The immediate minute following a feared outcome can be ordinary and procedural. This explains how catastrophe imagery often skips the mundane continuation that comes next.

top_50.name: SHARED-FACT CENTRE
top_50.mind_bend: One mutually verifiable fact can create common ground without requiring agreement about motives or interpretations. One implication is a stable centre for interaction.

top_50.name: URGE FALSE START
top_50.mind_bend: A motor plan can begin in imagination and still be aborted before completion. What changes is an early zone where initiation has occurred but commitment has not.

top_50.name: VALUE TRADEOFF
top_50.mind_bend: Two genuine values can point in different directions at the unchanged time. Moral conflict is a real trade-off rather than evidence that one value must be fake.
